description: Proposed Flood Levee Bank is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Mitchell Shire Council. A map layer showing the location of the proposed levee bank in Seymour. The location of the levee has had minor changes during the planning process and will probably change again as the process continues. Coverage: Mitchell Shire Council. The portal files it under the publisher Mitchell Shire Council. Its tags are Economy, Elevation, Goulburn River, Inland waters, Seymour. It offers 4 resource(s) in geojson, shp, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
